backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing weekly user display names, points, and rankings with week-reset logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, related files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of various frontend files describing their roles in state, UI, and persistence.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes and UI color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file mounting the React app and loading the main TypeScript entrypoint.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app controller handling routing, login gating, theme init, and backend display-name sync.
frontend/src/backup/backupIO.ts: Backup import/export utilities creating JSON backups and validating/migrating imported files.
frontend/src/backup/backupSchema.ts: Backup schema with validation and migration logic ensuring compatibility with user profile and gamification fields.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Circul: Animated SVG circular progress component displaying a percentage with color-coded states.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Subjec: Displays attendance stats for a subject with percentage, streaks, trends, and alerts in a clickable card.
Provides the main app layout with optional header and footer and spacing to avoid bottom nav overlap.
frontend/src/components/markToday/MarkTo: Bottom sheet for marking today's classes by loading today's timetable and saving attendance events.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Botto: Mobile-friendly bottom navigation bar with icons, active state styling, and tab switching.
frontend/src/components/settings/AboutCa: Shows app branding, logo, version info, and founder details with theme-aware logo switching.
frontend/src/components/settings/BackupR: Enables exporting and importing backups with confirmation before restoring saved app state.
frontend/src/components/settings/Notific: Manages browser notification settings with permission handling, warnings, and test notification sending.
frontend/src/components/settings/TargetP: Slider and input to set the user’s target attendance percentage.
frontend/src/components/settings/ThemeSe: Controls theme mode and color variant selection for app appearance settings.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Confirm: A reusable confirmation dialog for destructive actions with customizable title, description, and confirm handler.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Subject: Dropdown menu providing edit, reset, and delete actions for a subject.
Dialog for creating or editing a subject with validation and save handling.
frontend/src/components/system/ErrorBoun: React error boundary that displays a fallback UI and allows reloading the app.
frontend/src/components/system/InitialLo: Animated splash screen showing the app logo and loading indicators during initialization.
frontend/src/components/system/NonBlocki: Utility component that displays non-blocking toast notifications for errors.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceCalculatio: Pure functions for computing subject stats, overall attendance, bunk/required counts, insights, and streaks.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceReducer.ts: Reducer handling all attendance-related state updates including subjects, events, timetable, exchanges, settings, and gamification.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceTypes.ts: Type definitions for subjects, events, settings, streak milestones, and the overall app state.
frontend/src/domain/premiumInsights.ts: Calculations for premium insights such as trend prediction, trend direction, and streak messages.
frontend/src/domain/streakMilestones.ts: Utilities for computing continuous streaks and determining milestone eligibility.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, handling login, stored identities, and status flags.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and theme variables for light, dark, and midnight modes with motion‑reduction support.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports branding constants and helpers returning theme‑aware logo asset paths.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Contains small utility helpers for class merging, ID generation, date formatting, and color selection.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/notifications/localNotifica: Generates notification titles and messages for class marking events.
frontend/src/notifications/notifications: Wraps the browser Notifications API with permission checks and safe notification creation.
frontend/src/pages/HomeDashboardPage.tsx: Renders the main dashboard, handles marking attendance, triggers notifications, and awards streak milestone points via backend integration.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Implements a simple name‑based login form with validation and user profile creation.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Renders the settings UI, handling user preferences, profile display, and navigation to weekly ranking.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectDetailsPage.ts: Displays detailed subject stats with calculations, recent activity, and edit/reset/delete actions.
frontend/src/pages/TimetablePage.tsx: Provides a weekly timetable grid with an edit mode for assigning subjects to time slots.
frontend/src/rank/rankApi.ts: Defines API helpers for registering names, submitting points, and fetching weekly rankings from backend.
frontend/src/rank/RankPage.tsx: Fetches and displays the weekly leaderboard with loading, error handling, and rank icons.
frontend/src/state/appStore.tsx: Implements global app state via React context with reducer, loading from persistence, and debounced saving.
frontend/src/state/persistence.ts: Loads and saves app state to IndexedDB, validating structure and merging defaults for missing fields.
frontend/src/storage/indexedDbClient.ts: Low-level IndexedDB client for opening the database and reading, writing, or clearing stored state.
frontend/src/theme/themeManager.ts: Applies light/dark mode and theme variants based on settings, and listens to system theme changes when set to system.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, content paths, extended colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata including version, architectural notes, known issues, and descriptions of existing features.
